name: Weyl differencing
statement: Repeated finite differencing lowers polynomial phase degree at the cost of higher moments and shifted correlations.
translation_to_pvg: Decode valuation vectors to integers, then retain shifted additive phases; exact reindexing only.
claim_ceiling: No nontrivial estimate follows from reindexing alone.

name: van der Corput inequality
statement: A finite exponential sum is bounded through averaged shifted correlations, with constants and shift range explicitly specified.
translation_to_pvg: Shifted products become correlations between decoded PVG point weights under additive integer displacement.
claim_ceiling: Finite checks do not establish an asymptotic exponent pair.

name: Weyl-type polynomial-phase bound
statement: A nontrivial bound requires degree, rational approximation data, interval length, coefficients, constants, and uniformity range.
translation_to_pvg: PVG preserves phase inputs after decoding but does not supply Diophantine approximation or cancellation.
claim_ceiling: No new Weyl bound is proved here.

name: Exponent-pair estimate interface
statement: Exponent pairs summarize reusable bounds for oscillatory sums after valid A/B-process transformations.
translation_to_pvg: Diagnostic metadata on a translated sum; not a geometric invariant of valuation vectors.

name: Minor-arc certificate
statement: A minor-arc conclusion must name the arc set, sum, norm, uniform bound, and comparison scale against the major-arc main term.
translation_to_pvg: Addition-fiber Fourier modes can be reindexed in PVG, while the cancellation certificate remains analytic.
claim_ceiling: Minor-arc domination is not inferred from Fourier identity.

name: Finite cancellation ratio
statement: The ratio |S|/sum|a_n| measures observed finite cancellation but is not an asymptotic theorem.
translation_to_pvg: Exact scalar observable after faithful reindexing.
claim_ceiling: Cannot be extrapolated uniformly without proof.

name: Shift-correlation pushforward
statement: sum_n a_{n+h} conjugate(a_n) e(f(n+h)-f(n)) is represented after decoding PVG points and applying additive displacement h.
translation_to_pvg: Exact reindexing with decoded-integer shift; not intrinsic coordinate addition in valuation space.
claim_ceiling: The shift is additive in integers, not componentwise in valuations.

name: Finite cancellation does not imply uniform estimate
statement: Observed cancellation for finitely many parameters does not prove a uniform Weyl or minor-arc bound.

name: PVG reindexing does not create cancellation
statement: Exact ANT-PVG reindexing preserves a sum but supplies no oscillatory estimate.

name: Sample minor-arc smallness does not prove Goldbach
statement: A sampled or finite-grid minor-arc bound is not a uniform continuum estimate and does not establish binary Goldbach.

name: Lean status
statement: No project-owned Lean proof of van der Corput or Weyl differencing is added in this unit.
